about: A copy of the standard shared record list (sce:std/shared/record_list.scxml) run with no Mesh router (`router` false: the driver gives it none), as on one device whose host attached no link. Every send to a peer is refused where it is made, as error.execution, and each change the copy makes is taken in all the same, because what a copy does to itself is queued before anything is sent to a peer (docs/adr/0046, section 4): a person writing over a value holds the new one. Expected values come from a model of the list, not from a backend.

steps.note: started with no Mesh router: every send to a peer is refused where it is made
the host names the copy, node 1, which has no route to its peers and keeps no journal: a test throws it away
a person's change is taken in here although the send of it fails
a change over the field writes over the value it saw and holds the new one: the change is taken in before the send that fails
another field of the row is written beside it
